days.title: Descriptive statistics on right-skewed healthcare claims
Probability distributions and hypothesis tests: is the PPO cost gap real?
Confidence intervals and the bootstrap: how big is the effect, give or take?
A/B testing, sample size and power: design the experiment before you run it
EDA with matplotlib and seaborn: which chart answers which question
Correlation and simple linear regression: read a slope, R squared and a residual plot
Multiple regression and dummy variables: holding the others fixed (week 1 mini-report)
Categorical outcomes: chi-square, relative risk and odds ratios on 30-day readmissions
Comparing many groups: ANOVA, Kruskal-Wallis, post-hoc tests and the multiple-testing trap
Time series EDA: rolling means, seasonality, and telling a real shift from a bumpy week
Missing data and outliers: why it's missing, what's impossible, and how to fill the holes honestly
Confounding and risk adjustment: Simpson's paradox, standardization and O/E ratios for a fair hospital comparison
Survival analysis: censoring, Kaplan-Meier curves, log-rank and Cox hazard ratios for time to readmission
Explain vs predict (week 2 wrap-up): odds ratios, a train/test split, AUC, calibration and lift on 30-day readmissions
Decision trees: splits, Gini impurity, overfitting and cross-validated depth on 30-day readmissions
Random forests: bagging, out-of-bag AUC and permutation importance on 30-day readmissions
Gradient boosting with XGBoost: residuals, learning rate, early stopping and CV tuning on 30-day readmissions
Imbalanced outcomes: the accuracy trap, precision-recall, and choosing a threshold on 30-day readmissions
k-means clustering: unsupervised patient segments, scaling, choosing k, and profiling on the readmissions data
PCA and dimensionality reduction: turning a correlated 9-test lab panel into kidney, blood-sugar and heart axes
The week 3 model scorecard: baseline, logistic, tree, forest and XGBoost in one fair race, then test once and save with a model card
Predicting length of stay: MAE, RMSE, R squared and residual plots on hospital discharges
Ridge and Lasso on multicollinear length-of-stay features: shrink, zero, and read stable coefficients
Feature interactions and polynomial terms: when ICU plus a procedure is more than the sum, on length of stay
Learning and validation curves: diagnosing under and overfitting on length of stay
Data leakage and pipelines inside cross-validation: honest scores on length of stay
The week 4 regression scorecard: seven models in one fair race, test once, and a model card
